note: Vessel tree, batch 2: popliteal artery, the genicular arteries with their anastomosis, the descending genicular artery and the anterior tibial recurrent artery. Both sides (S = Left or Right). Diameters in mm (start, end). terminal = the only kind of end that may taper; continuesInto / parentPending name vessels of a later batch.

vessels.at: femoral artery, in the adductor canal

origin.en: Femoral artery, in the adductor canal just above the adductor hiatus
origin.zh: 股動脈，在內收肌管內、內收肌裂孔上方

course.en: Runs down in front of the medial side of the knee and splits into a saphenous branch, which accompanies the saphenous nerve, and an articular branch to the knee joint
course.zh: 沿膝內側前方下行，分為伴隨隱神經的隱支與到膝關節的關節支

supply.en: Medial side of the knee, the skin over it and the knee joint; joins the genicular anastomosis
supply.zh: 膝內側、其表面皮膚與膝關節；參與膝關節動脈網

vessels.en: Saphenous branch of descending genicular artery
vessels.guide: {S} saphenous branch of descending genicular artery

course.en: Accompanies the saphenous nerve down the medial side of the knee and leg, deep to sartorius
course.zh: 伴隨隱神經，在縫匠肌深面沿膝與小腿內側下行

supply.en: Skin and fascia of the medial knee and upper leg
supply.zh: 膝內側與小腿上部的皮膚和筋膜

vessels.en: Articular branch of descending genicular artery
vessels.guide: {S} articular branch of descending genicular artery

course.en: Runs in front of the femur, through vastus medialis, to the upper border of the patella
course.zh: 在股骨前方穿過股內側肌，到髕骨上緣

supply.en: Knee joint capsule and the patellar network
supply.zh: 膝關節囊與髕骨周圍動脈網

origin.en: Femoral artery, at the adductor hiatus

course.en: Runs down the popliteal fossa as its deepest structure, behind the popliteal vein and the tibial nerve, and divides at the lower border of popliteus into the anterior and posterior tibial arteries
course.zh: 在膕窩內下行，位於膕靜脈與脛神經的深面（最深層），在膕肌下緣分為脛前動脈與脛後動脈

supply.en: Knee joint, the muscles around the knee and, through its terminal branches, the leg and foot
supply.zh: 膝關節、膝周肌肉，並經終支供應小腿與足

relations.rule: tibial nerve most superficial, then popliteal vein, then artery (deepest)

vessels.at: popliteal artery, at the level of the femoral condyle or tibial condyle

course.en: Winds forwards above the medial femoral condyle, under the tendon of adductor magnus
course.zh: 繞過股骨內側髁上方向前，經內收大肌腱深面

supply.en: Lower end of the femur, vastus medialis and the medial side of the knee joint
supply.zh: 股骨下端、股內側肌與膝關節內側

vessels.at: popliteal artery, at the level of the femoral condyle or tibial condyle

course.en: Winds forwards above the lateral femoral condyle, deep to biceps femoris
course.zh: 繞過股骨外側髁上方向前，經股二頭肌深面

supply.en: Lower end of the femur, vastus lateralis and the lateral side of the knee joint
supply.zh: 股骨下端、股外側肌與膝關節外側

vessels.at: popliteal artery, at the level of the femoral condyle or tibial condyle

course.en: Runs along the upper border of popliteus, then below the medial tibial condyle, deep to the medial collateral ligament
course.zh: 沿膕肌上緣，再繞過脛骨內側髁下方，經內側副韌帶深面

supply.en: Upper end of the tibia and the medial side of the knee joint
supply.zh: 脛骨上端與膝關節內側

vessels.at: popliteal artery, at the level of the femoral condyle or tibial condyle

course.en: Runs below the lateral tibial condyle, deep to the lateral collateral ligament
course.zh: 繞過脛骨外側髁下方，經外側副韌帶深面

supply.en: Upper end of the tibia, the fibular head region and the lateral side of the knee joint
supply.zh: 脛骨上端、腓骨頭周圍與膝關節外側

vessels.at: popliteal artery, behind the knee joint

origin.en: Popliteal artery, behind the knee joint

course.en: Pierces the oblique popliteal ligament and enters the intercondylar area of the knee
course.zh: 穿過膕斜韌帶，進入膝關節的髁間區

supply.en: Cruciate ligaments, the synovial membrane and the menisci
supply.zh: 十字韌帶、滑膜與半月板

course.en: Arches in front of the femur above the patella and ends in the superior lateral genicular artery
course.zh: 在髕骨上方、股骨前方成弧，連到膝上外側動脈

supply.en: Capsule and synovial membrane of the knee; links the genicular arteries into one network around the joint
supply.zh: 膝關節囊與滑膜；把各膝動脈連成環繞關節的動脈網

course.en: Arches below the patella, over the patellar ligament, and ends in the inferior lateral genicular artery
course.zh: 在髕骨下方、髕韌帶前面成弧，連到膝下外側動脈

supply.en: Capsule and synovial membrane of the knee; links the genicular arteries into one network around the joint
supply.zh: 膝關節囊與滑膜；把各膝動脈連成環繞關節的動脈網

vessels.zh: 膝關節動脈網內側連結

course.en: Runs down the medial side of the knee joint and ends in the inferior medial genicular artery
course.zh: 沿膝關節內側下行，連到膝下內側動脈

supply.en: Capsule and synovial membrane of the knee; links the genicular arteries into one network around the joint
supply.zh: 膝關節囊與滑膜；把各膝動脈連成環繞關節的動脈網

vessels.zh: 膝關節動脈網外側連結

course.en: Runs down the lateral side of the knee joint and ends in the inferior lateral genicular artery
course.zh: 沿膝關節外側下行，連到膝下外側動脈

supply.en: Capsule and synovial membrane of the knee; links the genicular arteries into one network around the joint
supply.zh: 膝關節囊與滑膜；把各膝動脈連成環繞關節的動脈網

vessels.at: anterior tibial artery, just below popliteus

origin.en: Anterior tibial artery, just after it reaches the front of the leg
origin.zh: 脛前動脈，剛到小腿前區處

course.en: Climbs through tibialis anterior to the front of the lateral tibial condyle and joins the genicular anastomosis
course.zh: 穿過脛前肌向上，到脛骨外側髁前方，加入膝關節動脈網

supply.en: Tibialis anterior and the front of the knee joint
